findings.body: Raise: Not done. When the review is active during close's tests, the new assertion accepts `row["worker"]["kind"] == "review"`, but the next status assertion still requires the row to say tests are running. `src/forge/board.py:483` sets that status to `Review running` whenever a review worker is present, so the test still fails in the Linux scenario this fix targets.

findings.body: Raise: Gate. The Done-when includes passing main's full test run, but the commit's proof list names only the focused board test and `tests/test_rules.py`. Neither is the full `pytest tests` run configured in `forge.toml:6`, so the proof list omits that required detail.

why: Main's full test run fails on Linux: a board test expects no worker while close's tests run, but the review now runs alongside the tests and shows on the board
